title: ID0389938-DC/Si-D/EE- [50OR54] - Põltsamaa both routers are unavailable and charger stuck in 30%
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Failsafemode active
Root cause:
Router 1 and Router 2 are stuck
Solution:
Replace both routers
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
Note to QM:
After charger installation, both routers are unavailable and only power LED is ON. Unable to do factory reset because nothing happened.
We tried to ping 10.20.17.1 and 10.20.17.2 but nothing happened. When pinging 10.20.17.100, EcoG web server opened.  Laptop was connected directly to the routers but no any effect.

additional_info.subject: ID0389938-DC/Si-D/EE- [50OR54] - Põltsamaa both routers are unavailable and charger stuck in 30% CRM:00315002061
additional_info.body:
Hello Markus,
Short summary, we replaced the router from XF3 initially as it wasn't working, that was the reason why Failsafemode was active. After replacing the XF3, we could reach SCB again but then we found that XF4 was also faulty, we couldn't reach the WebUI and when we tried to do factory reset it it was still not possible to reach it. When we replaced the XF4 at first it didn't work, but apparently it is now working for an unknown reason.
Let me know if this is everything and I will close the ticket.
Best regards,
Francisco
